_doc: THE GRAVITY PROTOTYPE (SW-83, his third word; RUNNING_LOG §273): ONE gravity moment in ONE hand, with a few lead-in and lead-out notes of the same hand, nothing of the other hand. The workshop's page 'prototype' is drawn from this file. page = the IR the notes are read from · hand L|R · window = what the page shows · arc: t0 = the first note of the cluster, bounce = the impact, t1 = the last note · in / out = which notes stand on which side of the impact (the AI's first reading — HIS TO DECIDE; 'could be all on one side') · the arc's shape is the lineage's GC (notation/lib/gc.js: fall 1 - u^p, rebound to `damping` %) with the registry's preset, the fall lasting t0 -> bounce and the rebound bounce -> t1.

flow._note: §279: the ebb and flow — the busyness curve (each played note a bell sigmaS wide, as tall as its loudness, summed) stretched between its own low and high, raised to `power` (the exaggeration), filled to the strip's base; never under `floor` of the strip. The player reads it freely: density, acceleration or loudness.

shapeRule._note: §276 · §279 (the AI's rule, his to move): shape 1 = the pitches up to AND WITH the impact; shape 2 = the pitches after it, drawn only when the two sets differ by changeMin pitches or more (added + dropped), its box BEGINNING afterImpact of the way up the rising arc — never at the impact (his word)
shapeRule._clusterNote: §277 (his word: clusters as a bar with noteheads on top and bottom, the actual top and bottom note, with accidentals): a shape of clusterMinNotes or more pitches with no gap over clusterMaxGap semitones is a CLUSTER BAR — its lowest and highest note and a bar between their centers, clusterBarW of a head wide (piece 2's cluster bar, NOTATION_SYSTEM_PLAN §17e.1, was one head wide and had no heads; the narrower width is the AI's, his to move)
